Let me think about this year's plan for my 10.1 mu.

I keep my fields split the way I have for years: about 6 mu for the wheat-maize rotation, and 4.1 mu for cotton on the sandier piece near the road. My wife helps at peak times but our son works in Handan now, so I can't stretch too thin.

**Wheat (winter, 6 mu):** I planted last October already — improved variety, Jimai 22, same as last year because my neighbor Old Wang got over 500 kg/mu with it. At planting I put down 2 bags of diammonium phosphate per mu (that's about 36 kg DAP, giving me roughly 6.5 kg P and 6.5 kg N), plus one bag of potassium sulfate per 2 mu. I will top-dress with urea at the green-up stage after Qingming — about 20 kg urea per mu, which works out to 9 kg N. So total N around 15-16 kg/mu. Irrigation: one winter water already went on in December, then green-up water, jointing water, and grain-filling — 4 times total. I spray twice: once for aphids and powdery mildew mixed together around jointing, once before heading. I expect about 480 kg/mu if the spring stays normal.

**Maize (summer, 6 mu):** After wheat harvest in June I plant Zhengdan 958, no-till direct seed into the wheat stubble — saves time and diesel. At sowing I use compound fertilizer 15-15-15, about 40 kg/mu. Then top-dress urea at big trumpet stage, 25 kg/mu — that's about 11.5 kg N. Total N around 17 kg/mu. Summer rain usually covers things but I irrigate once at tasseling if July is dry, and one more at grain fill. Spray once for corn borer with the village drone service — cheaper than walking the rows myself now. I hope for 550 kg/mu.

**Cotton (spring-autumn, 4.1 mu):** Cotton is more work but the price held up last year so I keep it. Plough in March, improved Bt variety seed. Base fertilizer: 40 kg compound 15-15-15 per mu plus 15 kg urea worked in. Then topdress urea 10 kg at squaring and 10 kg at flowering. Total N about 20 kg/mu because cotton is hungry. Irrigate from the well 3 times — planting, flowering, boll-filling. Pesticide I spray 4 times — Bt cotton handles bollworm but aphids, mirids, and spider mites still need spraying. Expect about 240 kg/mu seed cotton.

I will not change much from last year. Prices of urea went up a little but I cannot cut fertilizer — if yield drops 50 kg I lose more than I saved.
